notes.title: 0.4.2.1 - Demo minor bugfix patch
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- Main character sometimes getting stuck under sloped ceilings

notes.title: 0.4.2.0 - Demo improvements
notes.notes:
Improved:
- Some platforms and enemies placement

notes.title: 0.4.1.0 - Demo improvements
notes.notes:
Improved:
- Enabled left analog stick as an alternative to d-pad
- Tweaked the first two Crystal Hollow rooms to make the starting experience a bit more forgiving

notes.title: 0.4.0.9 - Demo bugfix patch
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- Main character's collision shape corruption when crouching during the room transition

notes.title: Vulpis Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
Vulpis Demo is live and going to participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest: October 2023.

Enjoy playing and don't forget to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2427840/discussions/0/3882722797152136846]leave feedback[/url]!

The Demo will remain active until the end of Steam Next Fest on Oct 16.
